decided_by: Alexander Kell (architect), AD-290; delegated to the manager 2026-11-03
rationale: AD-290 adds the archkeel.studio package with its api, workspace and server components, the cli requirement on studio, archkeel.studio in ROOT-LAYOUT and archkeel.studio.api as an enum owner in TYPES-ENUM-IN-MODEL. validate --against origin/main measures calls_unresolved 830 before and 844 after, net +14: 17 new unresolved calls in archkeel.studio (stdlib receivers: the inherited ThreadingHTTPServer and BaseHTTPRequestHandler methods, Popen, cookie and query parsing, bytes and str methods), 4 in the cli wiring of studio (_contract_state, studio_workspace and the studio parser), and 7 calls in archkeel.analyzer that leave the unresolved list (start and close receivers in dart.parse, dart.resolve, process and typescript.config).
